mcat_description.short: Shed Construction refers to the end-to-end design, fabrication, and erection of steel-framed shed structures — primarily Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — for industrial, warehouse, agricultural, and commercial applications in India.
mcat_description.long: Shed Construction in the Indian B2B market encompasses the complete service of designing, fabricating, and erecting steel-framed structures, with Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) being the dominant construction method due to their speed, cost efficiency, and large clear-span capability. These structures use primary steel frames (columns, rafters, crane beams) fabricated from high-strength steel plates per IS 800:2007, combined with secondary members (purlins, girts, eave struts) and roofing/cladding systems such as Galvalume sheets, PUF sandwich panels, or polycarbonate sheets. Applications span factory sheds, warehouse sheds, godown sheds, poultry and dairy farm sheds, mandi sheds, and canopy structures, with buyers typically procuring on a turnkey or supply-and-erect basis quoted per square foot of covered area. Structural design must comply with IS 800:2007 (steel structures), IS 875 (load codes), and local municipal building regulations, with steel material grades typically conforming to IS 2062 E250/E350.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Shed Construction' is dominated by Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) technology, where steel components (columns, rafters, purlins, bracing) are factory-fabricated and bolted together on-site, enabling construction timelines significantly faster than conventional RCC methods. The primary structural design standard is IS 800:2007 ('General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice', Third Revision, BIS), which governs load combinations, member design, connections, fabrication, and erection for all steel shed structures including industrial sheds, warehouses, and canopies. Steel material grades typically conform to IS 2062 E250/E350 (hot-rolled structural steel). Roofing and cladding systems include Galvalume/colour-coated profiled sheets, PUF sandwich panels, Rockwool panels, and polycarbonate sheets depending on insulation and light-transmission requirements. The Indian market has two dominant buyer segments: (1) industrial/commercial buyers (factory, warehouse, logistics) who represent the majority of demand by value, and (2) agricultural buyers (poultry, dairy, cattle) who represent a significant volume segment particularly in South India and rural markets. Key manufacturing hubs for PEB shed contractors include Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, and the NCR belt. Buyers typically procure on a turnkey basis (design + supply + erect) quoted per sq ft of covered area. IS 875 (load codes for wind, seismic, and dead/live loads) is also referenced alongside IS 800 for complete structural compliance.
